bandwidth.note: WebSocket payload bytes (protocol frames); no WS/TCP/TLS framing; sessions of at least 5 s

clientTick.note: measured by the clients during the steady window; includes harness scheduling noise (the harness shares the host)

coldStart.note: process spawn to GET /control/health = 200, and to the public port accepting TCP

label: shutdown-sigterm
label_note: baseline slice only, not full-game capacity

meta.command: rh-load run --server-bin target/release/rh-server --out-dir target/load/final --hardware-label Apple M5 Pro 18-core 64 GB --matches 6 --duration 30 --aggression 0.9 --shutdown-at 15 --shutdown-mode sigterm --drain-wait 240 --label shutdown-sigterm
meta.executionNote: client harness and server share this host; harness CPU is reported separately

server.cpuMethod: ps -o cputime= delta over wall time (1.0 = one busy core); 10 ms resolution on macOS
server.metricsNote: cumulative since server start (a fresh server per run); stepUs is one room's simulation step, per step; quantiles are histogram bucket upper bounds (<= 25% above true); there is no server-side p95

shutdown.note: a fresh Welcome after the trigger would be an admission the draining server should have refused; resume Welcomes are allowed (held seats)
